Led by Eric Nelson since June 2022, succeeding church planters Paul and Jini Robie. Multi-campus church with 5 Utah locations. churches.name: Hope Church Richmond

score_notes.mens_discipleship: Men's discipleship likely but structured program details unconfirmed.

churches.assessment: Hope Church Richmond is an Acts 29 church plant in the Richmond metro. Acts 29 is a network of Reformed, missional, church-planting churches that hold to complementarian leadership, Calvinist soteriology, inerrancy of Scripture, and expository preaching. Pastor Kevin Yi leads a diverse, gospel-centered congregation focused on reaching the city. Acts 29 affiliation provides strong doctrinal guardrails and network accountability. A strong option for those seeking Reformed theology in a contemporary, missional context.
churches.gender_detail: Acts 29 requires complementarian leadership — male elders/pastors only
